summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.copyWithin following all ten spec steps in order, with the step comments kept above the code. ToObject, LengthOfArrayLike, ToClampedIndex (via a local helper), HasProperty, Get, Set(throw=true) and DeletePropertyOrThrow are all called with `?`. The from/to/count arithmetic and the direction rule match steps 6–8. The loop's observable order matches step 9 (both keys built, then HasProperty, then Get/Set or Delete). The remaining not-implemented paths come from the engine's Proxy and ArrayBuffer gaps and are reported as errors, not made-up values. No test-shaped branches, swallowed errors or unrelated edits were found. The renamed `_new_target` parameter is a consequence of the body no longer using it.
notes_for_next_attempt: No blocking issues. Non-blocking: the local to_clamped_index helper is documented as "not yet in ops". If ops already exports an equivalent (I could not check ops), use it instead of the local copy. If other built-ins (fill, slice, TypedArray methods) will need ToClampedIndex, it should move to ops in a separate ticket. The Proxy [[HasProperty]] and ArrayBuffer failures are engine gaps, not defects in this diff.
